entries.title: Hosea 12:1
segments: ¶Ephraim's food is the wind, and he goes after the east wind: deceit and destruction are increasing day by day; they make an agreement with Assyria, and take oil into Egypt.

entries.title: Hosea 12:2
segments: The Lord has a cause against Judah, and will give punishment to Jacob for his ways; he will give him the reward of his acts.

entries.title: Hosea 12:3
segments: In the body of his mother he took his brother by the foot, and in his strength he was fighting with God;

entries.title: Hosea 12:4
segments: He had a fight with the angel and overcame him; he made request for grace to him with weeping; he came face to face with him in Beth-el and there his words came to him;

entries.title: Hosea 12:5
segments: Even the Lord, the God of armies; the Lord is his name.

entries.title: Hosea 12:6
segments: So then, come back to your God; keep mercy and right, and be waiting at all times on your God.

entries.title: Hosea 12:7
segments: ¶As for Canaan, the scales of deceit are in his hands; he takes pleasure in twisted ways.

entries.title: Hosea 12:8
segments: And Ephraim said, Now I have got wealth and much property; in all my works no sin may be seen in me.

entries.title: Hosea 12:9
segments: But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; I will give you tents for your living-places again as in the days of the holy meeting.

entries.title: Hosea 12:10
segments: My word came to the ears of the prophets and I gave them visions in great number, and by the mouths of the prophets I made use of comparisons.

entries.title: Hosea 12:11
segments: In Gilead there is evil. They are quite without value; in Gilgal they make offerings of oxen; truly their altars are like masses of stones in the hollows of a ploughed field.

entries.title: Hosea 12:12
segments: And Jacob went in flight into the field of Aram, and Israel became a servant for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

entries.title: Hosea 12:13
segments: And by a prophet the Lord made Israel come up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept safe.

entries.title: Hosea 12:14
segments: I have been bitterly moved to wrath by Ephraim; so that his blood will be on him, and the Lord will make his shame come back on him.
